usageNotes: Returns the cluster-wide storage configuration index — all storage definitions visible to the authenticated user based on Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace permissions. Use this to enumerate available storage backends before querying node-level storage status or allocating disk resources. This is a cluster-level endpoint and does not reflect per-node availability or current usage; use get_node_storage for that.

examples.summary: List all NFS storage backends across the cluster

tips: Omit the 'type' filter to get all storage definitions in one call — useful for building a full inventory of what backends are configured.
The response reflects storage configuration, not real-time availability; a storage may be listed here but offline on a specific node.
PBS (Proxmox Backup Server) storage entries returned here represent configured backup repositories, not general-purpose datastores.
Results are permission-filtered — users without Datastore.Audit or Datastore.AllocateSpace on a storage will not see it in the list.
